scope: Implemented NEW prospective retained-result XLSX persistence/readback through the existing authorized workspace CLI and private-file contract. Not historical-original XLSX recovery, publication, scientific acceptance or operator approval.

authority.binaryReader: Same read command with --xlsx-stdout writes exact retained bytes to authorized shell stdout, not an HTTP/public resource.

supportedPersistenceInspection.existingDatabase: server/snapshots/results.ts stores strict analysis-result-1 JSON in immutable cv_analysis_snapshots/cv_analysis_chunks. Existing result payloads cannot be extended in place.
supportedPersistenceInspection.genuineParentReader: loadAnalysisResult verifies result/manifest identities and referenced material, calculation-source, workbook and ordered overlay dependencies. Capture and read both use this reader, never current inputs or caller-supplied proof.
supportedPersistenceInspection.chosenPersistence: One versioned private JSON envelope per 64-hex request identity, containing exact capture metadata and base64 original captured bytes. Existing directory must be explicitly configured, absolute, canonical, non-symlink, owned by current operator uid and 0700. Every ancestor is checked top-down with lstat: directories only, operator/root owned, and no nonsticky group/world write.

ancestorSecurityReview.problem: A 0700 leaf alone cannot prevent an untrusted user replacing it through a writable nonsticky parent between validation and file IO.
ancestorSecurityReview.fix: Both read and capture validate every ancestor before file access; capture repeats the complete path validation before atomic publication. Symlink ancestors and untrusted-owned or nonsticky group/world-writable ancestors refuse.
ancestorSecurityReview.stickyRationale: A sticky ancestor owned by root or the existing operator is permitted because other uids cannot remove/rename its trusted-owned next component. Every next component is independently ownership-checked. This is filesystem access validation, not a new role or HTTP authority.
ancestorSecurityReview.observedPlatform: This DEV container has root-owned / mode 1777 and operator-owned /tmp mode 1777. Both are trusted-owner sticky directories. Their broad permissions were inspected, never changed.
ancestorSecurityReview.tests: Private temporary parent fixtures set to 0777, 0775 and 0770 refuse both read and capture with no leaf files created. A symlink ancestor refuses. A normal nested 0700 private directory under tmp succeeds; trusted-operator-owned sticky 1777 parent succeeds. All fixture permissions and files are cleaned in temporary directories only.
ancestorSecurityReview.scopeResidual: Same-uid operator or root can deliberately replace trusted components or change their modes after validation; that already-authorized owner/root adversary remains outside application-level append-only guarantees. No untrusted writable nonsticky ancestry is accepted.

supportedPersistenceInspection.logicalAppendOnly: Atomic hardlink no-replace publication from a synced exclusive 0600 staging file in the same private directory, then staging unlink and directory fsync. Existing target is never overwritten, upgraded or repaired.
supportedPersistenceInspection.idempotency: Same request ID and parent returns original capture ID, capture time and exact bytes. Different parent conflicts. Existing malformed/inaccessible/version-unknown records refuse instead of recapture.

privateHttpBoundary.readAndCapture: All HTTP methods deny 403 without opening the private store. No genuine HTTP principal exists, so CLI authentication is not misrepresented as HTTP authority.

atomicPublicationReview.identifiedWindow: link(staging,target) temporarily exposes nlink=2 before unlink(staging).
atomicPublicationReview.resolution: Reader does not accept or read a multiply-linked file. It polls fstat up to ten times with 25ms delays only for nlink=2, then still requires nlink=1. A persistent hardlink remains refused; nlink>2 is refused immediately. File size, link count and modification/change timestamps are rechecked after a bounded read.
atomicPublicationReview.forcedCrossProcessInterleave: Test child hardlinks an actual captured private fixture, announces the two-link state and waits for parent release. Parent starts read inside nlink=2; child unlinks staging after release. Reader succeeds only after nlink=1, with exact original bytes.
atomicPublicationReview.concurrency: Five concurrent same-request captures select one immutable winner; four different request IDs retain separate exact readbacks. Actual DEV CLI also ran two concurrent distinct-request captures.
atomicPublicationReview.collisionFailureCleanup: Competing invalid target is inserted after initial absence check. Link collision refuses target without overwrite, and finally removes the staged file.
atomicPublicationReview.waitBound: At most ten 25ms timer waits plus filesystem/event-loop scheduling; not a real-time guarantee. A writer paused beyond this bound can cause a safe transient refusal; retry after publication cleanup is supported.
atomicPublicationReview.crashResidual: Process death before staging unlink can leave an orphan staging file or nlink=2 committed target. Reader refuses rather than auto-repairs. Authorized owner cleanup/recovery is separate; no automatic deletion of retained files is implemented.

actualDevLifecycle.execution: Passed against genuine existing DEV retained parent using actual operator CLI child processes, explicit private ephemeral directory and genuine retained reader.
actualDevLifecycle.checksumMethod: SHA256 canonical ordered existing header fields plus PostgreSQL md5(payload::text) per chunk; actual parent independently reloaded and content-hashed before/after.

tests.initialPortableCountMismatch: One preliminary expanded run had all 37 nested source tests passing but stale outer expected-count 35. Updated the helper assertion to 37; final 33/33 focused run passed.

remainingGapsAndBoundaries: No permanent private directory activated; DEV engineering files were retained/read across actual CLI processes then fully removed. A genuine operator must explicitly select/provision a private existing directory for lasting retention.

Filesystem contract is application-level append-only, not OS WORM or protection against the authorized same-uid owner/root. All ancestors are verified operator/root-owned, non-symlink, and not group/world-writable unless sticky. Concurrent malicious replacement or permission changes by that already-trusted owner/root remain outside this boundary. No new elevated authority is claimed.

No HTTP operator authentication exists. Private HTTP remains forbidden, not a claim of authenticated HTTP success. Actual running-app restart/runtime verification belongs to the main agent; this work verified mounted Express fixtures and source wiring without restarting workflows.
No public disclosure/download activation, publication rights review, operator approval or scientific/model acceptance.
No historical-original XLSX attachment was reconstructed or added to the old 124 records. Every captured workbook is explicitly NEW prospective output.
No source-bundle or raw private bytes checked into Git. No DDL, commits, deploys, callbacks, ledgers, release matrix, old golden or protected model pins changed by this lifecycle work.
Broader chart/custom-export consumers and producer coverage remain separate coordinated work; this lifecycle only captures the existing verified retained result serializer.
